question: Which of the following is a small hand-held pointing device that controls the twodimensional movement of the cursor on a screen?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mouse**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **mouse** is a small hand-held pointing device that is used to control the movement of the cursor on a computer screen.
 
• The mouse operates in a **two-dimensional motion**, enabling the user to interact with objects on the screen by pointing, clicking, dragging, and dropping.
 
• It typically consists of buttons and a scroll wheel, which allow users to perform various functions such as selecting, scrolling, and dragging. *Hence, the correct answer is Mouse.*
 
• The mouse can be connected to the computer via a wired connection or wirelessly, making it a convenient and versatile input device.
 
• It is the most commonly used pointing device for personal computers and is integral to graphical user interfaces (GUIs).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mouse:**

 
 
• The **mouse** was invented by **Douglas Engelbart** in **1964**, and it revolutionized the way users interact with computers.
 
• Modern mice come in various designs, including optical mice, laser mice, and wireless mice, offering enhanced precision and convenience.
 
• **Applications:** They are extensively used in applications requiring graphical interactions, such as **gaming, designing, and general computer usage.**
 
 
 
• **Scanner:**
 
 
• A scanner is used to convert physical documents or images into a digital format. It is not a pointing device.
 
• **Functions:** Scanners are commonly used for document digitization and image editing purposes.
 
 
 
• **Touchscreen:**
 
 
• A touchscreen is an input device that allows users to interact directly with the display by touching it. It is not a hand-held device like a mouse.
 
• **Applications:** Touchscreens are widely used in smartphones, tablets, ATMs, and kiosks.
 
 
 
• **Keyboard:**
 
 
• A keyboard is an input device used to type characters and commands into a computer. It is not a pointing device.
 
• **Features:** Keyboards have a variety of keys, including alphanumeric keys, function keys, and special keys.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Types of Mice:**

 
 
• The **mechanical mouse** uses a rolling ball to detect movement and is one of the earliest types of mice.
 
• The **optical mouse** uses light sensors to track movement, offering greater precision and durability.
 
• The **wireless mouse** operates via Bluetooth or RF technology, offering portability and eliminating the hassle of cables.
 
 
 
• **Evolution:**
 
 
• In **1981**, **Xerox** introduced the first commercial mouse with its computer system.
 
• Today, advanced mice are equipped with features such as programmable buttons and ergonomic designs for enhanced user experience.
